name: Hisame Sayaka
source:
Class: Old-Fashioned Sword Girl
Skill: Hisame Secret Sword Art

A strong swordswoman, she values traditions and honor. Fiercely loyal if beaten. She doesn't know much about the world of love and becomes embarrassed easily.
